# Thorne

## Overview

- **Gender:** Male
- **Status:** Alive
- **Rank:** Commander / Fleet Officer
- **Role:** Military Commander
- **Titles:** Commander

## Appearance

Thorne is a stern military officer who typically wears standard tactical or fleet uniforms. He carries himself with a rigid, disciplined posture reflecting his long-standing background in strategic command.

## Personality

Thorne is pragmatic, disciplined, and strictly adheres to protocol and chain of command. He prioritizes efficiency and practical tactical outcomes over sentimentality. Though cautious and demanding of his subordinates, he remains committed to duty and tactical success.

## Traits

- Disciplined
- Pragmatic
- Tactical-minded

## Abilities

- Fleet command and strategy
- Tactical coordination

## Goals

- Maintain order and security under his jurisdiction
- Execute military directives efficiently

## History

Thorne serves as a high-ranking officer involved in overseeing military and fleet operations. Across the early events of the series, he manages tactical deployments and coordinates security logistics during escalating conflicts. His strict enforcement of protocols frequently puts him at odds with more unorthodox operatives, yet his strategic decisions prove vital in maintaining order during major fleet engagements. Through the events up to Volume 5, he continues to hold command, navigating complex political pressures and battlefield crises.

## Background by volume

- Served through military ranks to earn a position of fleet command.

## Affiliations

- Military Fleet Command — Commander
